# Disagreement Log — GTH_089

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 89
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 89 | "do you not understand" | "do you not realize" | "don't you see" | Cognitive verb: understand vs. realize vs. see |
| 2 | 89 | "he who made" | "the one who made" | "whoever made" | Creator reference: personal *he* vs. neutral *the one* vs. anonymous *whoever* |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "understand" (cognitive-spiritual knowing) and "he who made" (preserving the personal creator reference).
